Revenue Model

Transparent pricing.
0% Provider Commission.

No subscriptions. No hidden provider commissions. Customers book verified nearby professionals with transparent base prices and a small platform fee — while providers keep 100% of their service earnings.

Browse verified professionals free

See real names, ratings, distance, years of experience, and skill tags — all visible before you commit to anything.

Direct service bookings

Book verified local providers with transparent base pricing and 0% provider commission — no middleman markups.

Direct deal, zero middleman

Connect via phone or WhatsApp directly. Negotiate your job or schedule service online — on your terms.

Only serious professionals listed

Every provider is Aadhaar-verified before going live. Ratings come from real customers — fake reviews are detected and removed.

Get Started

For every side
of the platform.

For Households

Find the right professional in your neighbourhood.

Open the app, tap your service, see who's nearest. Pay only when you want to connect.

For Service Professionals

Get discovered by customers near you.

Set your skills, your radius, and go online. Customers who are ready to pay find your profile instantly.
